reason: Provides shell scripts and source patches that modify DeepSeek Harness to bind its Web UI to a specific LAN IP, preserve rejection of 0.0.0.0, and enable trusted-host access; this materially expands network access to an agent capable of arbitrary command execution, requiring human review.

summaries.zh: 通过应用和撤销补丁的脚本，将指定版本的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 配置为从局域网指定 IP 访问。
summaries.en: Applies and reverts patches that configure a specified DeepSeek Harness version to serve its Web UI from a selected LAN IP.

capabilities: applies and reverts patches through shell scripts
rebuilds and configures a web UI
binds the UI to a specified LAN IP
enables access to an agent capable of executing arbitrary commands from other LAN devices
